# rr_ui — LVGL screens + idle watch face (spec Phase 4/6)
#
# Phase 4: fonts (Noto Latin+Greek), emoji from littlefs, and the static step
# screen. Watch face (§9B) is still absent.
idf_component_register(
    SRCS "src/rr_ui.c"
         # Generated LVGL fonts (Noto Sans, Latin + Greek). They live in
         # assets/fonts/ because they are build ARTEFACTS regenerated by
         # tools/gen-fonts.sh, not hand-written source.
         "../../assets/fonts/rr_font_20.c"
         "../../assets/fonts/rr_font_28.c"
         "../../assets/fonts/rr_font_36.c"
    # assets/emoji carries the GENERATED emoji_manifest.h lookup table.
    INCLUDE_DIRS "include" "../../assets/emoji"
    REQUIRES lvgl__lvgl waveshare__esp32_c6_touch_amoled_2_06 rr_store
)
